title: Correspondence-Guided 轻量 6D Pose 架构筛选

protocol.research_question: 能否围绕 2D-3D correspondence 构造一个逻辑统一、训练/推理更高效且保持合理竞争精度的完整 6D pose pipeline，并明确比较显式几何求解与 correspondence-guided direct regression 的 accuracy-efficiency trade-off？
protocol.core_information_flow: RGB -> lightweight visual features -> 2D-3D correspondence -> pose

candidate_A.name: explicit_geometry_reference
candidate_A.pipeline: Light Backbone -> correspondence + reliability/coverage -> weighted PnP -> R,t
candidate_A.purpose: geometric reference and deployment candidate only if measured Pareto is competitive
candidate_A.assumption_boundary: PnP/RANSAC/iterative solving is not assumed fast or slow; actual GPU and end-to-end latency must be measured

candidate_B.name: asymmetric_rt_direct_regression
candidate_B.pipeline: Light Backbone -> correspondence -> rotation-specific / translation-specific representations -> direct R,t + geometric consistency
candidate_B.rotation_cues: normalized/canonicalized correspondence, internal and relative geometry, camera-normalized 2D/rays where appropriate
candidate_B.translation_cues: absolute 2D position, ROI/bbox scale, camera intrinsics K, object extent and other metric cues
candidate_B.coupling_rule: R/t are not assumed mathematically independent; allow only explicit, interpretable cross-branch coupling when needed
candidate_B.geometric_constraint: predicted correspondence and predicted pose must be consistent under camera projection; GT correspondence/pose supervision remains the anchor to avoid self-consistent-but-wrong solutions

module_policy.backbone: re-evaluate from efficiency and correspondence localization needs; do not inherit ConvNeXt-Base by default
module_policy.region: not required by default; reintroduce only with explicit evidence and defined role
module_policy.mask: retain only the minimum visibility/support signal required by correspondence formation; full/amodal mask is not assumed necessary
module_policy.pose_decoder: do not reuse a fully shared late latent by default
module_policy.new_modules: each module must solve an identified problem in the correspondence-to-pose chain

decision_matrix.A_good_B_bad: learned correspondence-to-pose mapping remains the primary bottleneck; do not keep stacking direct decoders
decision_matrix.A_bad_B_bad: fix correspondence frontend/representation before pose decoder work
decision_matrix.A_bad_B_good: inspect whether direct branch uses valid extra context or shortcut before accepting
decision_matrix.A_good_B_good: select by measured accuracy-efficiency Pareto and stability

directly_supported: Dense XYZ correspondence contains strong pose information under explicit geometric diagnostics.
CPM Region-conditioned low-order moment compression failed under its tested implementation/protocol.
EXP012 E10-to-E15 degradation is predominantly rotation-specific while translation behaves differently.
Improving predicted XYZ toward GT does not stably improve the EXP012 learned pose output, and synced Region does not provide a reliable rescue.
EXP012 checkpoint interpolation provides QC-PASS evidence of smooth BOP/AR_reS degradation along the E10-to-E15 parameter line.
plausible_not_proven: Rotation and translation benefit from different learned representations.
Asymmetric R/t information routing can reduce late rotation instability.
Geometric consistency can make direct regression use correspondence more faithfully.
A lightweight frontend can retain enough correspondence quality for competitive pose accuracy.
missing_key_evidence: Measured latency and accuracy of weighted PnP versus direct regression under the same frontend.
Whether R/t representation factorization improves E10-plus stability rather than only early metrics.
Which correspondence representation and reliability/coverage mechanism gives the best efficiency trade-off.
Whether Region/full-mask removal is neutral or beneficial after the frontend is redesigned.
